title: Config
description: GET /api/config. NEVER contains the key value — only a presence flag (CONTRACTS.md §6).

adapter.description: Selected adapter id, or null if unset.

youtube_key_present.description: Whether a YouTube Data API key is stored locally. The value is never returned.

anthropic_key_present.description: Whether an Anthropic API key is stored locally (direct adapter). The value is never returned.

openai_key_present.description: Whether an OpenAI API key is stored locally. The value is never returned.

openrouter_key_present.description: Whether an OpenRouter API key is stored locally. The value is never returned.

gemini_key_present.description: Whether a Gemini API key is stored locally. The value is never returned.
